selected_evidence.summary: ip/ifconfig showed each node's interfaces; unique-subnet arping isolated which physical NICs are actually L2-paired (node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1 transit; node1.eth2<->node3.enp8s0; node2.vtnet2<->node4.enp8s0)

selected_evidence.requirement: VyOS (node1) WireGuard + routing configuration applied and persisted
selected_evidence.summary: wg0/eth1/eth2 configured via VyOS configure/commit/save; wg show and ip route show confirm addresses, peer, and static route to private-B are active; 'show' after reboot (later) confirms persistence

selected_evidence.requirement: OPNsense (node2) interface assignment, WireGuard instance, and firewall rules applied
selected_evidence.summary: config.xml patched with opt1/opt2/opt3 and wireguard server/client entries; interface reconfigure and wireguard configure show opt1/opt2/opt3 up with correct IPs and wg0 handshake established with node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Fix OPNsense boot-time WireGuard bring-up bug so tunnel survives reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Root-caused missing /usr/local/etc/wireguard dir and non-functional wg-service-control route/address application; installed rc.syshook.d/start/96-wg-fixup and proved it reconstructs wg0 address+routes from a cold state

selected_evidence.requirement: node3/node4 private addressing persists across NetworkManager reconciliation and reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Raw ip addr add was reverted by NetworkManager; nmcli-managed connection profiles (manual ipv4 method + static route) applied and held

selected_evidence.requirement: Hosts reach each other by private address; traffic travels inside the WireGuard tunnel
selected_evidence.summary: node3 (10.0.1.2) <-> node4 (10.0.2.2) ping succeeds both directions; tcpdump on the node1-node2 transit link shows only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard packets, no plaintext ICMP

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node1 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id/uptime/wg/route captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; new boot_id + reset uptime confirmed; wg0/routes/ping to node3 verified recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node2 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime/hostuuid/wg/routes captured; reboot acknowledged; new kern.boottime (12s before current time) confirms fresh boot; wg0 address/routes restored by the syshook fixup; handshake re-established and node3<->node4 ping verified working

selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id/uptime/route/ping captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; new boot_id + reset uptime confirmed; NetworkManager-managed enp8s0 address/route and ping to node4 verified recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node4 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery

function wireguard_services()
{
    $services = [];

    if (!wireguard_enabled()) {
        return $services;

        }

    }
